-- Phase 1: spec only. The body is filled in during Phase 2.
-- pick is pure: it uses no capabilities and no nondeterminism.
-- The index is seed % length, so the same seed always gives the same element.

pick(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> int =
  pre xs.len() >= 1
  post out == xs[seed % xs.len()]
  ex pick([10, 20, 30], 4) == 20
  ex pick([7], -1) == 7
  let i = seed % xs.len()
  xs[i]

test_pick() =
  assert pick([10, 20, 30], 5) == 30
  assert pick([10, 20, 30], 5) == pick([10, 20, 30], 5)
